findings.evidence: `Contractable.conditionallyIIDWith_directingProbabilityMeasure` at TauCeti/Probability/DeFinetti/ViaL2/ConditionallyIID.lean:72-75 has the same binders `[StandardBorelSpace α] [Nonempty α] [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hX : Contractable μ X) (hX_meas : ∀ n, Measurable (X n))`; `Exchangeable.contractable` (Contractability.lean:180) supplies the bridge, exactly as `deFinetti_viaL2` (ViaL2/Theorem.lean:73-78) does. findings.issue: `deFinetti_tendsto_empiricalMeasure_apply` concludes `∃ ν, ConditionallyIIDWith μ X ν ∧ …`, i.e. the limit is an opaque witness obtained from `ConditionallyIID.exists_directing`. The repo's canonical directing measure `directingProbabilityMeasure μ X` (DeFinetti/DirectingMeasure/Basic.lean:118, with its measurability, `directingProbabilityMeasure_toMeasure`, `directingMeasure_ae_eq_condExp` API, and `deFinettiMeasure` built from it) is available under exactly the hypotheses of this theorem, so as stated a consumer holding `directingProbabilityMeasure μ X` cannot conclude it is the empirical limit without a separate uniqueness argument (Unique.lean:198 needs `[IsProbabilityMeasure μ]` and gives only per-set a.e. equality).

findings.evidence: `weighted_sums_converge_L1` (Exchangeability/L2/Cesaro/Convergence.lean:338), Exchangeability/L2/Cesaro/ToCondExp.lean:138 and Exchangeability/L2/TailMeasurability.lean:142 all take `{f : α → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hf_bdd : ∃ C, ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)`.
findings.fix: Use the existing spelling `(hf_bdd : ∃ C, ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)` in the three theorems (or at least make `C` explicit).
findings.issue: The bounded-observable hypothesis is spelled `{C : ℝ} (hbdd : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C)` — with `C` implicit, `apply h.tendsto_average_ae hX hf` leaves the bound goal with an unresolved `?C`. The rest of the Exchangeability surface uses `(hf_bdd : ∃ C, ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)`, so the two bounded-observable families do not compose without repacking. Same at line 151 (`tendsto_integral_empiricalMeasure_ae`) and TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Integral/ProbabilityMeasure.lean:52-53 (`measurable_probabilityMeasure_integral`).

summary: The headline de Finetti corollary hands back an anonymous existential witness although the repo already has the canonical `directingProbabilityMeasure μ X` available under exactly these hypotheses, so the limit cannot be connected to the existing directing-measure/`deFinettiMeasure` API. The new bounded-observable hypothesis also diverges from the spelling the rest of the Exchangeability surface uses.
